# Files a PR may change without needing a Verdict (ADR 0013): docs, tests and the process files
# the owner reviews anyway. A PR that changes only these gets a passing "Verdict" status at once.
# Every other file needs a Verdict, so a new kind of file is judged until it is listed here.
# One path per line: a trailing / means everything under that folder; * matches within one name.

# Docs
docs/
README.md
CLAUDE.md
CONTEXT.md
LICENSE

# Tests (CI runs them; the Verdict judges what the app does)
packages/*/test/
scripts/test/
e2e/

# CI, PR process and agent skills (protected paths: the owner reviews them)
.github/
.claude/
scripts/verdict.ts
scripts/protected-paths.ts
scripts/before-after.ts
scripts/glossary-lint.ts
